resources.string: Taildrive between a person\'s own devices
Each member\'s devices share folders and open them on that member\'s other devices. Writes both attributes and the grant Taildrive needs.
Also writes the grant that lets members open shares on their own devices, to read and to write. Narrow it afterwards on the Access page.
The policy has a Taildrive grant already, and it stays as it is. Check on the Access page that it lets these devices open each other\'s shares.
